AN ACTION PLAN FOR RAIL ENERGY AND EMISSIONS INNOVATION 71 Integrating electricity and transportation system plans and investments is critical to building a national network of decarbonized fueling infrastructure. Integrating planning and investment spanning the transportation and electricity systems is essential to accelerating the cost-effective build-out of robust fueling infrastructures across the United States. The increasing demand for electricity, directly for EVs, and indirectly to produce low carbon fuels, requires a commensurate response that accelerates the accommodation of these new end uses into electricity policy, utility regulation, and the deployment of needed energy infrastructure.
